title: Modern 1BR Near Gulch & Broadway With Pool
description:
Welcome to your Nashville retreat - a cozy base near Broadway & The Gulch for relaxing between city adventures!

- Sleeps 6 | 1 bedroom | 2 beds | 1 bath
- Rooftop sky lounge w/ city views
- Shared gym & BBQ area
- Kitchen w/ dining table
- Washer & dryer, Wifi, TV

The space
Welcome to your comfortable Nashville retreat near The Gulch and Broadway. This modern 1BR apartment is designed as a relaxed home base for couples, friends, small groups, business travelers, and weekend getaways.

Sleeping Arrangements

🛏️ Bedroom
• Queen bed with fresh linens
• Clothing storage for easy unpacking

🛋️ Living Area
• Sleeper sofa
• Air mattress
• Sleeps up to 6 guests

Kitchen and Dining

🍳 Fully equipped kitchen with everyday essentials
☕ Coffee maker
🍽️ Dining table for meals, work, or trip planning
🧼 Dishwasher, oven, toaster, and cooking basics

Living Space

🛋️ Cozy open living area with natural light
📺 TV for streaming and entertainment
📶 WiFi for work or relaxing indoors
❄️ Air conditioning for year-round comfort

Convenience and Essentials

🧺 Washer and dryer
🧴 Shampoo and shower gel
👕 Hangers and iron
🛏️ Bed linens provided

Building Amenities

🌆 Rooftop sky lounge with city views
💪 Shared fitness center
🏊 Shared outdoor pool
🔥 Shared BBQ area
🚗 Secure garage parking available for $35/night

Location Highlights

🍽️ Minutes from The Gulch dining and shopping
🎶 Close to Broadway live music and nightlife
🎤 Near Ryman Auditorium and Downtown Nashville attractions
🏟️ Convenient to Bridgestone Arena and Music City Center

This space is perfect for guests who want a quiet, comfortable place to recharge while staying close to Nashville’s best restaurants, music venues, and entertainment.

Guest access
Guests will have full private access to the apartment and shared access to the building's community amenities.

🔑 Access to the building is provided via a key fob. One key fob will be available for your use during your stay and can be used to access the building and applicable common areas.

Please note that the building allows only one key fob per reservation, so we are unable to provide additional fobs. We recommend coordinating with your group accordingly.

Guests may access:

🏊 Outdoor pool

💪 Fitness center

🌆 Rooftop sky lounge with city views

🔥 Shared BBQ area

🏢 Building common areas

🚗 Secure garage parking available for $35/night

Detailed check-in instructions will be sent prior to arrival.

Other things to note
Please Note: While we strive to provide a comfortable and enjoyable stay, we are not responsible for the maintenance or availability of building amenities such as the pool, gym, elevator, or laundry facilities, as these are managed by the building. Refunds will not be issued for any amenity that is unavailable or out of service during your stay.

🏢 Building amenities and common spaces are shared with other residents and guests.

📹 Security cameras are present in common areas of the building, including the courtyard, parking areas, lobby, sky lounge, and pool.

🚭 No smoking or vaping inside the apartment or in prohibited building areas.

🚗 Parking is available for $35/night.
